bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Silver price volatility; long approval cycles in defense/aerospace; slow adoption of sub-assemblies due to lifecycle testing; entry of new HV players; global recession impacting power CAPEX; regulatory delays in RoHS transition
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, strategic, and long-term oriented; emphasizes operational excellence (Lean Six Sigma), customer consolidation as tailwind, and global compliance; transparent on silver price impact; avoids forward guidance on margins due to commodity risk
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Modison's HV monopoly is structurally protected by high technical barriers (KEMA/CESI testing costs); silver price volatility is a feature, not a bug — variable pricing contracts and inventory management mitigate risk; B2C silver compounds are a stealth value driver with export potential; defense engagement is a multi-year play with non-financial strategic upside
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Established in 1965 with a pioneering role in setting the '999' Good Delivery Silver Bars standard in India, demonstrating deep metallurgical expertise.
- Long-standing presence in electrical contact manufacturing since 1977, serving diverse high-reliability industries (switchgear, automotive, aerospace, defence).
- Recognized as a leading manufacturer in the electrical contact industry, with a wide customer base and growing international footprint.
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Raw material price volatility and supply chain disruptions — The company's manufacturing operations depend on key raw materials whose prices are subject to market fluctuations, potentially impacting margins and production continuity.
- Customer and geographic concentration — A significant portion of revenue may be derived from a limited number of customers or specific regions, exposing the company to demand shocks or relationship-specific risks.
- Technological obsolescence and competitive pressure — Rapid advancements in manufacturing technology and intense competition could erode the company's market position if it fails to innovate or maintain cost leadership.
- Regulatory and compliance risks — Changes in environmental, safety, or industry-specific regulations could increase compliance costs or disrupt operations, particularly given the nature of the manufacturing facilities.
- Foreign exchange rate fluctuations — As a company potentially engaged in exports or imports, adverse currency movements could impact revenue realizations and input costs, affecting profitability.
- Key personnel dependency and succession planning — The company's performance is closely tied to its leadership and skilled workforce; loss of key personnel without adequate succession could impair strategic execution.
- Economic cyclicality and demand slowdown — The company's products are linked to industrial and infrastructure activity, making it vulnerable to macroeconomic downturns that reduce capital expenditure by end-users.

business.body: Modison Limited manufactures electrical contacts and contact materials, including silver and silver alloy wires, plates, strips, and solid/bimetal contacts. The company serves OEM customers across power distribution, power transmission, automotive, railway, aerospace, marine, defence, engineering, and pharmaceuticals, with a growing presence in international markets. Its operations are built on metallurgical expertise in precious metals, originating from silver refining and bullion trading.
business.title: What they do

business.body: - **Electrical Contacts & Materials:** silver and silver alloy wires, plates, strips, solid/bimetal contacts
business.title: Products & brands

business.body:
- Modison HV Private Limited — subsidiary: Wholly owned subsidiary (100% shareholding).
- Modison Solartech Private Limited (formerly Modison Hitech Private Limited) — subsidiary: Ceased to be a subsidiary with effect from June 09, 2025.
- Modison Copper Private Limited — related party: Part of the Promoter Group. Transactions involve purchase and sale of goods and/or availing and rendering of job work and related services in the ordinary course of business.
business.title: Group structure (profile)

business.body:
- Established in 1965 with a pioneering role in setting the '999' Good Delivery Silver Bars standard in India, demonstrating deep metallurgical expertise.
- Long-standing presence in electrical contact manufacturing since 1977, serving diverse high-reliability industries (switchgear, automotive, aerospace, defence).
- Recognized as a leading manufacturer in the electrical contact industry, with a wide customer base and growing international footprint.
business.title: Competitive strengths

latest_quarter.body: LV: low single-digit EBITDA; HV: high double-digit EBITDA; gross margin volatility driven by silver prices (80-90% material cost); normalized EBITDA target: 12-14%; cost pass-through via variable pricing contracts; inventory turnover improved from 3x to 5x
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Rs.500cr revenue by FY25; Rs.1,000cr by FY30; growth to exceed market CAGR of 15% in LV and high double digits in HV
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Growing due to global OEMs shifting production to India (Hitachi, Siemens, Schneider); new customer onboarding (Polycab samples under approval); defense engagements in progress
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Expansion into sub-assemblies (value chain upgrade); defense/aerospace contracts (DMRL/DRDO); silver salt exports (Clariant); automation and automotive contact segments; RoHS-compliant AgSnO2 product adoption
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

outlook.body:
- Focus on high-margin, value-added electrical contact products and assemblies for switchgear, EV, and renewable energy applications.
- Expand manufacturing capacity through greenfield and brownfield projects to capture growing domestic and export demand.
- Strengthen backward integration by developing in-house capabilities for critical raw materials like silver alloys and copper profiles.

outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: The company operates its manufacturing facility at Vapi, Gujarat (Plot No. 85A,B,D,E & 2923, 2924 A&B, E-Road, Phase-I, GIDC). The annual report does not disclose any new capacity addition, greenfield/brownfield expansion projects, or specific capex plans with commissioning timelines for FY26 or future periods. The net block (including CWIP) stood at Rs. 9,526.98 Lakhs as of March 31, 2026, reflecting ongoing capital work in progress, but no project-level details are provided.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Demand driven by government infrastructure push, electrification, renewable energy, and EV adoption.
- Margin improvement expected from higher share of value-added products and operating leverage as new capacities ramp up.
- Export growth supported by China+1 strategy and competitive manufacturing cost structure.
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers

deepdive.thesis: Modison Limited is India's sole integrated manufacturer of LV and HV electrical switchgear contacts, benefiting from global supply chain re-shoring, Make in India incentives, and RoHS-compliant product transitions, with strong market leadership in HV (80% share) and growing volume-driven revenue momentum despite silver price volatility.

open.item: The Board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 3.00 per equity share (300%) for FY2025-26, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM on July 21, 2026.
Greenfield project at Vapi for manufacturing electrical contacts and assemblies, expected to commence commercial production in FY27.
Enhance capabilities in advanced alloy development, precision engineering, and high-performance contact materials for EV infrastructure, renewable energy systems, and industrial automation.
Deepen customer relationships, expand presence in high-growth application areas, and increase focus on export markets to diversify revenue.
Focus on strengthening procurement strategies, improving operational efficiencies, and optimizing cost structures to mitigate raw material price volatility and supply chain risks.
Develop sustainable and energy-efficient product solutions aligned with global environmental standards.
Developing in-house capability for manufacturing silver alloys and copper wire to reduce import dependence and improve margins.
Members' approval sought for material related party transactions with Modison Copper Private Limited (MCPL) for an aggregate value up to Rs. 8,000 Lakhs from the 43rd AGM until the 44th AGM in 2027.
Special resolution proposed to enhance the overall borrowing limits of the Company under Section 180(1)(c) of the Companies Act, 2013, superseding all earlier resolutions.
